system.boundary: Build a differential tracked ground vehicle with a rigid chassis, two independently driven tracks, finite track inertia, and nonlinear frictional contact with the terrain.
engineering_objects: P9-XMECH01 plant and controller described by the current public task contract
Measured output interfaces: vehicle_motion, track_state, terrain_contact, drive_actuation
physical_paths: Drive forces must reach the chassis through the two track-terrain contact paths; directly prescribing chassis motion is not a valid implementation.

Across the declared range, regulate actual left and right track motion, produce the corresponding forward and differential-steering response through physical contact forces, remain dynamically bounded, and recover after the temporary traction loss.
functional_paths: Build a differential tracked ground vehicle with a rigid chassis, two independently driven tracks, finite track inertia, and nonlinear frictional contact with the terrain.
Drive forces must reach the chassis through the two track-terrain contact paths;
Read left_track_command, right_track_command, payload_mass, terrain_friction, grade_angle, left_traction_loss, and traction_event_time from base-workspace variables.
information_paths: left_track_command, right_track_command, payload_mass, terrain_friction, grade_angle, left_traction_loss, traction_event_time -> P9-XMECH01 plant/control path -> vehicle_motion, track_state, terrain_contact, drive_actuation
modes_and_events: Read left_track_command, right_track_command, payload_mass, terrain_friction, grade_angle, left_traction_loss, and traction_event_time from base-workspace variables.
The left-track friction coefficient is reduced by left_traction_loss for 1.2 s beginning at traction_event_time;
A reduced planar longitudinal-yaw chassis model is intended: no independent lateral-velocity state is required, and chassis translational velocity is aligned with the reported yaw direction.
